project.title: Manufactured Home Foundation, Site Plan and Entry Decks
project.subtitle: Permanent pier foundation, site plan and entry decks for a manufactured home
project.use: Multi-section HUD-code manufactured home. Foundation, support and anchorage system, site plan and freestanding entry decks.

summary.headline: Block piers on concrete pads, a perimeter wall and a strapped-down frame.
summary.text: The home is supported on block piers under each main frame I-beam and along the marriage line. Each pier bears on a reinforced concrete pad 24 in. below grade. A reinforced masonry perimeter wall on a continuous footing encloses the crawl space and provides resistance to anchorage forces.
summary.howToRead: Start with the site plan for where the home sits, then the foundation sheet, then the entry decks. On each sheet, read the overview and the construction sequence first. Blue is new work. Grey is the manufactured home or an existing site feature.
summary.sequenceNote: The illustrated construction sequence is provided to communicate general design intent. Construction means, methods, sequencing, temporary supports, equipment and jobsite safety shall be the responsibility of the contractor/installer. Maintain structural stability throughout all phases of installation.

facts.s: #3 @ 12 in. both directions. 26 in. at the 2 column piers
Anchors 6 in. above grade. 4 end ties per I-beam end

steps.title: Lay out, excavate and place concrete
steps.text: Set out the pads from the home's main frame lines and the wall footing around the perimeter. Excavate to 24 in. below finished grade on undisturbed soil. Place the reinforcing and dowels, then place the pads and the wall footing.
steps.hold: Footing inspection, and observation of the bearing soil, before concrete is placed.

steps.title: Build the piers and the perimeter wall
steps.text: Lay the block piers on the pads in mortar and grout all cells solid: single-stack under the frame I-beams, double-stack and interlocked along the marriage line. Lay the perimeter wall, set the strap anchors in the anchor course and grout the reinforced cells.
steps.hold: Reinforcing and anchor inspection before grouting.

steps.title: Set the home
steps.text: Set and level both sections on the piers with solid caps, shims and wedges, then join the sections per the manufacturer's instructions. Set the ridge-beam column piers and the door piers before the sections are joined.

steps.title: Tie down and close up
steps.text: Install the diagonal frame ties from each outer I-beam to the wall anchors, and the 4 end ties at each end of every I-beam, then tension them. Install the ground cover, vents and access, backfill both faces of the wall together and grade away from the home.
steps.hold: Tie-down inspection before the crawl space is closed.

scope.text: Reinforced concrete pads, 8 in. thick, bottom 24 in. below grade: 24 × 24 in. under the main frame I-beams and along the marriage line, 26 × 26 in. at the 2 ridge-beam column piers.
Single-stack 8×8×16 CMU frame piers at 8 ft max. Double-stack 16×16 CMU marriage-line piers at 8 ft max. Mortared, all cells grouted solid.

8 in. reinforced CMU perimeter foundation wall on a 16 × 10 in. continuous footing, bottom 24 in. below grade. Non-bearing; carries the strap anchors 6 in. above grade and encloses the crawl space. Ground cover, vents and access.
Diagonal frame ties at 8 ft max. each side and 4 end ties at each end of each I-beam, to listed anchors in the wall.
Two freestanding 5 × 5 ft entry decks with stairs, front and rear. Not connected to the home.
Placement of the home, driveway, decks and services on the lot.
Multi-section manufactured home built to the HUD Code. Structure, set-up and close-up are by the manufacturer and the installer.
Utility connections, boundary survey, grading and drainage design, driveway construction.

notes.title: Home
items: Manufactured home: two sections, 13'-2" × 48'-0" each. Main frame I-beams at 99½" o.c., 29¼" from each section edge, per the manufacturer's support drawing. Verify against the actual chassis prior to footing layout. Refer discrepancies to the engineer of record.

notes.title: Supports
items: Provide 28 main frame support piers and 7 marriage-line piers on 24" × 24" × 8" pads, and 26" × 26" × 8" pads at the 2 ridge-beam columns, as drawn. Pier and pad sizes are subject to the support reactions (open item).

notes.title: Construction
items: Bearing soil at each footing shall be observed by the installer before concrete is placed. [HOLD]
Sequence the perimeter wall and the home setting to maintain access; means and methods are by the installer.

notes.title: Site and decks
items: Site plan is drawn from owner-furnished information, the recorded plat and aerial imagery. It is not a boundary or topographic survey. Stake the home from the property corners and verify the setbacks before excavation. [HOLD]
Entry decks are freestanding and are not connected to the home. See sheet S2.0.

criteria.v: HUD-code, two sections, 26'-4" × 48'-0", HUD Wind Zone I

summary.headline: The home sits 18 ft from each side line and 30 ft back from the frontage.
summary.text: The lot fronts Example Drive. The home is set parallel to the side lot lines, with a 12 ft driveway on the right and the water, sewer and electric services entering on the left. The woodland at the rear of the lot remains.
summary.sequenceNote: The illustrated construction sequence is provided to communicate general design intent. Construction means, methods, sequencing, temporary supports, equipment and jobsite safety shall be the responsibility of the contractor/installer. Maintain structural stability throughout all phases of installation.

facts.s: From the frontage arc to the nearest corner
3 ft from the home, on the right
2,116 sq ft of 7,534 sq ft allowed

steps.title: Find the corners and stake the home
steps.text: Locate the property corners. Stake the four corners of the home 18 ft from each side line and 30 ft from the frontage, and check the diagonals.

steps.title: Locate and rough in the services
steps.text: Have existing utilities located. Trench the water, sewer and underground electric services along the left side of the lot to the home.
steps.hold: Utility inspections as required by the authority having jurisdiction.

steps.title: Build the foundation and set the home
steps.text: Construct the foundation and set the home per sheet S1.0. Keep trees and woodland outside the work area protected.

steps.title: Decks, driveway and final grade
steps.text: Build the entry decks per sheet S2.0, set the HVAC pad, pave the driveway and grade to drain away from the home on all sides.

summary.headline: Two freestanding decks on their own footings, one at each door.
summary.text: Each deck is 5 ft square on four 6×6 posts and four 12 in. concrete pier footings. The deck stands 1 in. clear of the home and is not fastened to it. A 4 ft wide stair leads down to grade, with the stringers anchored to a small concrete pad. The front and rear decks are the same.
summary.sequenceNote: The illustrated construction sequence is provided to communicate general design intent. Construction means, methods, sequencing, temporary supports, equipment and jobsite safety shall be the responsibility of the contractor/installer. Maintain structural stability throughout all phases of installation.

facts.s: 4×4 posts through-bolted at the corners. 2×2 balusters @ 5 in.

steps.title: Footings
steps.text: Lay out four footings per deck from the door centerline. Drill or dig 12 in. diameter holes to 24 in. minimum below grade and place the concrete. Keep the footings clear of the home's wall footing.
steps.hold: Footing inspection before concrete is placed.

steps.title: Posts, beams and joists
steps.text: Set the post bases and posts, then the two double 2×8 beams and the 2×8 joists and rims. Hold the deck 1 in. clear of the home.

steps.title: Decking and stair
steps.text: Lay the decking. Measure the finished height, place the concrete pad at the foot of the stair, cut the stringers for equal risers and anchor them to the pad.

steps.title: Guards and handrails
steps.text: Install the guards on the open sides of the deck and a graspable handrail along the stair.

geometry.source: Home configuration per the manufacturer's support drawing; verify in field.
geometry.padBars: #3 @ 12" each way, 3" clear from the bottom
geometry.pierNote: Open cells vertical, long side across the I-beam, Type S mortar, all cells grouted solid. Cure mortar 96 hrs before the home is set
geometry.capNote: Cap: 4" solid CMU or 2× hardwood. Hardwood shims and wedges driven tight, 1" max. total thickness. Level within ¼" between adjacent piers
geometry.pierMLNote: 16×16 solid cap. Also support at crossover duct penetrations of the rim joist
geometry.columnNote: Ridge-beam column piers at 15'-6" and 30'-0" from the hitch end, on 26" × 26" × 8" pads
geometry.wallNote: #4 @ 24" in grouted cells, hooked into the footing. Top course grouted, (1) #4 cont.
geometry.gapNote: 1" gap with compressible seal. Wall does not bear
geometry.anchorNote: (N) Strap anchor, inside face, in grouted anchor course with (2) #4. See general notes
geometry.clampNote: (N) Beam clamp at the top flange of the outer I-beam, rated for the strap load
geometry.strapSpec: (N) Galv. strap 1¼" × 0.035" min., ASTM D3953 Type 1, Grade 1, Finish B, tensioner each strap. Radius clips at sharp corners
geometry.endTieNote: (N) End ties, 4 per I-beam end at 35°. Attach to factory bracket, approved beam clamp or crossmember within 3" of the I-beam. Straps spread ≥ 12" o.c.
geometry.endTieClear: Strap must clear the end pier: offset each anchor ≥ 10" to the side of the I-beam line
geometry.endAnchorNote: (N) Strap anchors in the end wall anchor course, inside face
geometry.doorPierNote: Door piers each side of exterior doors, on 16" × 16" × 8" pads min. See general notes

site.easement: Utility easement along this side line. Verify width from the recorded plat
site.coverageNote: Areas and zoning data as furnished by the owner. Verify required yards with the local zoning administrator.
site.utilityNote: Service routes are schematic. Locate existing utilities before excavation. Utility connections, sizes and materials are by others and per the authority having jurisdiction.
generalNotes: This site plan is not a boundary or topographic survey. It was prepared from owner-furnished information, the recorded plat and aerial imagery. Property lines, easements and existing features are approximate; verify in the field.
No topography was furnished and no grades are shown. Grade the finished site to drain away from the home on all sides.
Locate the property corners, stake the home and verify the setbacks before excavation (hold point). Have missing corners set by a licensed land surveyor.
Verify required yards, easements, lot coverage and the driveway entrance with the local jurisdiction.
Call 811 before digging. Service routes are schematic; connections, sizes and materials are by others, per the utility and the authority having jurisdiction.
The woodland at the rear remains. Protect trees outside the work area. Erosion and sediment control per local requirements.
site.sourceNote: From owner-furnished information, the recorded plat and aerial imagery. Not a boundary or topographic survey

deck.baseNote: Listed post base with 1" standoff, anchored to the footing per its listing
deck.footingNote: Cast-in-place concrete pier footing, 12" dia. × 24" deep min., 3,000 psi
deck.joistTieNote: Joist to beam connection per the local deck construction guide
deck.capNote: Listed post cap, beam to post
deck.guardNote: Guard post and infill, 36" min. above the deck
deck.guardFixNote: (2) ½" dia. through bolts with washers to the rim and (2) to the end joist, staggered
deck.stringerNote: 2×12 stringers @ 12" o.c. max. Attach to the rim per the local deck guide
deck.riserNote: Equal risers within 3/8"; treads 10" run. Closed risers, or open risers that do not pass a 4" sphere. Fit to the measured threshold height within the 5'-0" stair length
deck.padNote: Concrete pad 12" wide × 4" thick × width of the stair, 3,000 psi
deck.treadNote: Treads 2×4 min., attached to each stringer with (2) 8d threaded nails or (2) #8 × 2½" screws
deck.toeNote: Simpson A34 each stringer to the pad
deck.guardPostNote: 4×4 guard post inside each deck corner and at mid-length of each side, 4'-0" o.c. max.
deck.guardBlockNote: 2×8 full-depth blocking tight to the post, fastened to the rim and joist
